name: ListTags

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Valid values:

Instance: A dataset acceleration instance.

Slot: A dataset acceleration slot
parameters.help_zh:
标签所属的资源的类型，取值如下：

Slot：数据集加速槽
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource to which the tag belongs.

If you set ResourceType to Instance, set this parameter to the ID of the dataset acceleration instance. For more information about how to obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467899.html.

If you set ResourceType to Slot, set this parameter to the ID of the dataset acceleration slot. For more information about how to obtain the slot ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467905.html
parameters.help_zh:
标签所属的资源的ID。

当ResourceType为Slot时，需要配置为数据集加速槽ID，如何获取数据集加速槽ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467905.html
